# Life Ready Learning Hub

> Free, plain-English financial education for Canadians, published by Leigh Grant Financial (https://www.leighgrant.ca) for the Life Ready Facilitated Care community and the public. The site offers articles, free financial calculators (including a Canadian mortgage comparison tool), a free Financial Success Checklist (PDF), a free Google Sheets spending plan template, and short videos (coming soon) covering budgeting, debt, credit, investing (RRSPs and TFSAs), insurance, and retirement planning in Canada.

This site is educational only. It is not a group benefits, group investment, or insurance portal, and nothing on it is personalized financial, tax, or legal advice. Questions can be sent to leigh@leighgrant.ca.

## Articles

- [How to Build a Budget That Actually Works](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/article-budgeting-basics): A simple, step-by-step budgeting guide for Canadians: find your real numbers, try the 50/30/20 split, automate your savings, and review monthly.
- [A Practical Plan for Paying Down Debt](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/article-debt-management): A step-by-step debt repayment plan for Canadians: list what you owe, compare the avalanche and snowball methods, and avoid common debt traps.
- [Credit Scores in Canada, Explained](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/article-credit-scores): What affects your credit score in Canada, why Equifax and TransUnion scores differ, and the simple habits that build good credit over time.
- [Investing Basics: RRSPs, TFSAs, and Compound Growth](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/article-investing-basics): How RRSPs and TFSAs work, why employer matching matters, how compound growth builds wealth, and how to choose investments that fit your goals.
- [Insurance Basics: Health, Dental, Life, and Disability Coverage](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/article-insurance-basics): A plain-English guide to extended health, dental, life, and disability insurance in Canada, plus how claims and pre-determinations work.
- [Retirement Planning in Canada: Where to Start](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/article-retirement-planning): Why starting early beats starting big, how CPP, OAS, RRSPs, and TFSAs fit together, and how to set a realistic retirement savings goal.

## Templates

- [Complete Financial Spending Plan](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/templates): A free, all-in-one Google Sheet covering everything from your monthly budget to your long-term goals. Tabs: Monthly Spending Plan, Personal Financial Snapshot, Dashboard, Goals Tracker, Accounts, Tax Savings, Budget Link. Direct link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17zQUAbBdKj6JEYIH6UAY_od7iSDD0XhGBIOnqNKUn90/edit?usp=sharing

## Calculators

- [Mortgage Repayment Calculator & Comparison Tool](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-mortgage): Free Canadian mortgage calculator: compare two mortgage scenarios side by side, with payment frequency, prepayments, CMHC insurance, and a full amortization schedule.
- [Monthly Budget Builder](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-budget): Build a monthly budget in minutes: enter your income and expenses, compare housing costs to benchmarks for your city, test what-if changes, and save a PDF.
- [Credit Card Minimum Payment Calculator](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-cc-danger): See how long it takes to pay off a credit card making only the minimum payment in Canada, how much interest it costs, and how much an extra payment saves.
- [Debt Avalanche vs. Snowball Calculator](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-debt-compare): Enter up to five debts and compare the avalanche and snowball repayment methods side by side with a real month-by-month simulation of interest and payoff time.
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-net-worth): Calculate your net worth in minutes by adding up what you own and what you owe, including your home, mortgage, savings, investments, and debts.
- [The Cost of Spending Today](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-opportunity-cost): See what a purchase today could be worth years from now if you invested it instead. A no-judgment opportunity cost calculator for everyday spending decisions.
- [Canadian Student Loan Repayment Calculator](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/calc-student-loan): Model Canadian student loan repayment with provincial interest rates, the live Bank of Canada prime rate, the grace period, and Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) eligibility.

## Downloads

- [Financial Success Checklist (PDF)](https://life-ready-dashboard.lucas-gil.workers.dev/Life%20Ready%20Checklist.pdf): A free, six-page printable PDF: a practical guide to building confidence with money, one step at a time. Created by Leigh Grant Financial.

## Videos

- Budgeting 101: Build Your First Spending Plan (coming soon): A short walkthrough of the 50/30/20 split and how to set up a monthly spending plan using the free template.
- Debt Payoff Strategies: Avalanche vs. Snowball (coming soon): How the two most popular debt payoff methods work, and how to choose the one you will stick with.
- How Credit Scores Work in Canada (coming soon): The five factors behind your credit score and the everyday habits that improve it.
- RRSP vs. TFSA: Which Account First? (coming soon): A side-by-side look at Canada's two most popular savings accounts and when each one makes sense.
- Insurance Basics in Five Minutes (coming soon): What health, dental, life, and disability coverage actually protect, and how to make a claim.
- Retirement Planning: Your First Steps (coming soon): How CPP, OAS, and personal savings fit together, and how to pick a starting contribution rate.
